description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Jax's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, his next basic attack [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] is empowered to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]] and consume all stacks to deal '''additional''' magic damage, reduced to 50% against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. While ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' is active, the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.
description.text: Passive: Jax's basic attacks generate a stack of Grandmaster-at-Arms on-hit for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, his next basic attack on-hit is empowered to have an uncancellable windup and consume all stacks to deal additional magic damage, reduced to 50% against structures. While Grandmaster-at-Arms is active, the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jax''' swings his lantern around, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits a champion, he gains [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor, increased for each champion hit beyond the first, and [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance equal to 60% of that amount as well as 10% increased [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|size]] for 8 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Jax swings his lantern around, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits a champion, he gains  bonus armor, increased for each champion hit beyond the first, and  bonus magic resistance equal to 60% of that amount as well as 10% increased size for 8 seconds.

description3.raw: '''''Jax''' can move during Grandmaster-at-Arms' cast time.''

notes.raw: * The on-hit deals [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc damage]]. The swing deals [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]]. * The bonus resistances are represented by a glowing aura around '''Jax''' that grows with each enemy champion hit beyond the first. * The '''additional''' magic damage can be [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] and [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] but it cannot [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|miss]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the additional damage from the third attack if it is [[File:Jax Empower.png|20xpx|border|link=Jax#Empower|An icon for Jax's ability Empower]] [[Jax#Empower|empowered]]. * The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]]. ** Stacks will still be generated when attacking them. * The empowered attack is applied in a separate damage instance from '''Jax's''' basic attacks. ** This causes effects like [[File:Bone Plating rune.png|20xpx|link=Bone Plating|An icon representing Bone Plating]] [[Bone Plating]] to be applied twice.(unexpected) * * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
The on-hit deals proc damage. The swing deals area damage.
The bonus resistances are represented by a glowing aura around Jax that grows with each enemy champion hit beyond the first.
The additional magic damage can be dodged and blocked but it cannot miss.
Spell shield will only block the additional damage from the third attack if it is empowered.
The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against wards.
* Stacks will still be generated when attacking them.
The empowered attack is applied in a separate damage instance from Jax's basic attacks.
* This causes effects like Bone Plating to be applied twice.(unexpected)
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
